newsitem.title: UK: Fairey launches bid for Burnfield.
newsitem.headline: Fairey launches bid for Burnfield.

text.p: Britain's Fairey Group said on Tuesday it was making a 51.1 million stg offer for Burnfield Plc.
The offer of one new Fairey share for every four Burnfield share values Burnfield at 51.1 million stg, 145.9 pence per share.
A full cash alternative is available of 135 pence per share.
The bid represents a premium of 48.1 percent over the closing price of Burnfield shares on Decemebr 16.
In pre-market trading Burnfield shares jumped 32-1/2p to 132-1/2p.
Electronics and specialist engineering manufacturer Fairey said the bid was conditional on Burnfield not proceeding with a proposed 24 million stg acquisition or associated rights issue.
The company said the purchase of Burnfield which manufactures heating systems, pressure and quality control equipment would produce both synergies and cost savings.
The offer was consistent with its strategy of growing its electronic control and processs technology interests, it said.
